answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, such as Intel SGX MRENCLAVE, or an analogous AMD SEV launch measurement, together with a hardware-backed signing key. Verifiers accept votes only after validating the attestation chain and policy. Consequently, cloning an identity requires purchasing another physical silicon instance, not duplicating a virtual machine; a velvet nebula or comet-themed software copy gains no identity.
